$comment: Interval templates for the HIIT style, and the structural parameters for the others.
This file is REFERENCE DATA for the phase-06 implementer, not something the app loads.
The engine implements these as code constants; keeping them here as well gives a
reviewer one table to check the implementation against.
Note the (rounds - 1): there is deliberately NO recovery after the final work
interval, because the cool-down serves that purpose. Getting this wrong is the
most likely arithmetic error in the whole engine.

budget_split.$comment: warmUp = clamp(round(T * fraction), min, max); coolDown = clamp(round(T * 0.10), min, 300); main = T - warmUp - coolDown.

hiit_templates.$note: The Norwegian 4x4. The only template with direct trial evidence; prefer it whenever the duration allows.

mixed_parameters.$comment: surgeCount = clamp(main / 300, 2, 5). If baseTotal < surgeCount * 120, drop one surge and recompute; below 2 surges, fall back to zone_2 and downgrade the title.
mixed_parameters.surge_placement: middle third of the main block; never in the first 90 s or the last 60 s

zone_2_parameters.$note: Splitting a steady block into segments does not change intensity. It exists so the coach can cue a change of position or cadence, and so the halfway cue has a boundary to land on.

recovery_parameters.$note: No ACTIVE_RECOVERY or REST segments; the whole block is already low intensity. Prefer variety: repeating a movement is most noticeable in a recovery session.

$transition_note: Inserted only between segments on different modalities. Charged against the block's own budget, which is why the worked example in spec §9 has a 70 s warm-up segment rather than 90 s.
